title: Legoland Discovery Center Chicago
specs: 12 unique LEGO attractions including themed play zones and interactive rides
Pirate Adventure Island playground with climbing, air cannons, and building activities
Adults must be accompanied by at least one child (age 17 or younger) to enter
Children (17 and under) must be accompanied and supervised by an adult (18+) at all times
Youth group field trips require organized groups of 10 or more children K-8 grade with tax exempt form or organization ID
School field trips require minimum 10 children K-5 grade with tax exempt form or school ID
Group rates require minimum 10 guests and advanced pre-paid reservations
For every 10 tickets purchased in friends & family groups, receive 1 free ticket
For every 5 child tickets purchased in school groups, receive 1 free adult chaperone ticket
includes: Access to 12 LEGO play zones, 2 interactive rides, 4D Cinema, and MINILAND Chicago
Admission includes all attractions except The Great LEGO Race Virtual Reality experience
gap: Age minimum for children not explicitly stated
blurb: Guests explore 12 unique LEGO attractions including interactive rides, a 4D cinema, and themed play zones. The center offers creative play spaces like Pirate Adventure Island with climbing and building activities. Visits are self-guided and typically last 2-3 hours.
extraNote: Tickets must be booked online in advance to guarantee entry and best price · Guests more than 30 minutes late may experience longer wait times · No outside food or beverage allowed inside the attraction · Re-entry is not permitted except for lunch break with staff permission · Main entrance at LEGOLAND Discovery Center sign and giant LEGO giraffe
